timeline.summary: On April 28, 2026, Menon Bearings informed the exchange that Crisil reaffirmed its credit ratings at CRISIL BBB+/Stable/A2 on ₹20.96 Cr of bank facilities.
On May 12, 2026, Menon Bearings disclosed postal ballot results approving the appointment of CFO Mr. Arun Aradhye as Managing Director.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹87.18 Cr (+36.6% YoY), net profit ₹13.78 Cr (+108.5% YoY).
Menon Bearings reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹87.79 Cr and net profit of ₹13.78 Cr.
Nitin Menon (Promoter) declared no new encumbrances on Menon Bearings shares by Persons Acting in Concert for FY2026, filed April 3, 2026.
Menon Bearings Limited held an earnings conference call for Q4FY26 and FY26 results on 19 May 2026 at 2:00 PM IST for investors/analysts.
Menon Bearings hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings call on May 19, 2026, guiding for FY27 revenue of over ₹360 Cr and maintaining EBITDA margins at 20-22%.
Menon Bearings reported Q1FY27 results with record revenue of ₹91.79 Cr, up 36.6% YoY, and announced plans for capacity expansion and new market entry
Menon Bearings released its Q2 & H1FY27 investor presentation, highlighting Q2 revenue of ₹100.88 Cr (+58.6% YoY) and capacity expansion updates across divisions.
Officials of Menon Bearings Limited held an earnings conference call on 30th October 2026 at 11.00 a.m. IST.
